main_text.p: Solent enim Rabbini eum qui assiduus est in opere suo, appellare טָרַח ex Prov.19.13. דלף טורד Stillicidium assiduum, ut Elias in Thisbi scribit.
טרח Ch.Laborare,fatigare,defatigare se,Eccl.2.10. Ps.56.6. Chaldaeis non ita frequens verbum, ut Rabbinis.
טָרְחָא טורְחָא, טורְחָא, טורַח Ch. Fatigatio, labor, molestia, onus.
טורְחוּתָא, טורְחוּת, טָרְחוּתָא, טָרְחוּרָ Ch. Idem.
טַרְכּוּנָא, טַרְכּוֹן, טַרְכּוּנָא Ch.Basilica, Palatium regium: Item Trachonitis regio. Respodet Hebraeo ארגוב: Deuter.33.4. in Jonath. legitur טַרְגּוּנָא per נ.
טרן טִירוּנִי, טִירוּנִי, טוּרְנִי, טוּרְנִין, & טִירוּנִין Chal. Τυραννοι, Tyranni, satrapae, principes, potentes.
טרס טוּרְסִים, טַרְסִים Ch. Tharsis, Oceanus.

טרף Syr. Percutere, verberare. Pahel טָרַף Ch. Percutere, quatere, concutere, conquassare, tundere, contundere, confternare, conturbare. Sic Syrè, Conturbati, conquassati, juxta Regia. Tremellius, Male habiti, ad Heb.11.37. Ithpah. אִתְטָרַף, & אִתְטָרַף Percuti, percelli, conquassari, allidi, collidi, conturbari, consternari: Rapi, abripi, Raptari,2.Sam.20.12. Syrè Et abrepti eramus,Act.27.27. Ithpeh. אִתְטָרַף Idem.
טָרִיף, טָרִיפָא Percussus,contusus: Item Raptum, Discerptū a feris bestiis proprie,ut Hebr. טְרִיפָה quod proin

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as best read from the scan; vowel pointing and some Syriac letters are uncertain. The Greek word after "Chal." is a reading of the printed form. The final line runs into the foot and ends at "proin" as printed.
